tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, dive into a twisting amnesia thriller where an ex-cop's past is a dangerous blank slate and every new face might be a foe. It's a gripping descent into paranoia that will keep you guessing until the credits roll.

releases.title: Model Citizen
releases.take: Amnesia, an isolated farm, and suspicious neighbors? Sounds like a 'relaxing' weekend getaway gone very, very wrong.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.take: Another night, another zombie apocalypse, proving that even medical couriers can't escape the undead's delivery service.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Man's best friend gets a truly wild adventure, proving that even a good boy can't escape a plane crash and the Alaskan elements.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: My critic's pick goes to Godzilla Minus Zero, a monumental achievement that reinvents the kaiju genre with poignant post-war trauma and breathtaking spectacle. It's not just a monster movie; it's an emotional gut-punch wrapped in cinematic awe.
